threshold_note: Distances are minimap fractions (map width = 1). All thresholds are tunable coach heuristics, not sourced game rules. A hero that is not visible is missing, never assumed dead or far away.
health_note: Top-bar health bars are not tied to specific minimap rings. Rings near you are some subset of the enemies with visible bars, so the coach uses the guaranteed range: worst case (healthiest) for danger, best case only when every candidate is low.

cards.speech: Gank warning: {count} closing on you {direction}. Fall back toward your guardian or a teammate.
cards.rationale: Enemies moving toward you from outside your fight are the visible start of a gank; without an advantage, reset.

sources.excerpt: Ganks: players might leave a lane to assist another.

cards.speech: You're outnumbered: {enemies} near you against {allies}. Back off until help arrives.
cards.rationale: More visible enemies than allies around you is a numbers disadvantage.

sources.excerpt: Engage only with an advantage: pick available, key ability landed, ult advantage, numbers/respawns

cards.speech: {count} near you went missing {seconds} seconds ago. Watch your back and don't push past your wave.
cards.rationale: Enemies seen near you that left the minimap may be repositioning for a gank.

sources.excerpt: enemy markers disappear from the minimap while the player pushes forward
Missing: pinging an enemy portrait (Tab + middle-click) warns allies the enemy is unaccounted for.

cards.speech: You have the numbers: {allies} against {enemies} nearby. Commit together.
cards.rationale: A visible numbers advantage, with your health confirmed and nobody near you missing, is a reason to engage as a group.

sources.excerpt: Group before committing; pick the fight location

cards.speech: Teammate in trouble at {area}: {allies} against {enemies}. Rotate to help if your wave is safe.
cards.rationale: A nearby ally fighting at a disadvantage can be turned by a rotation, if leaving does not cost your own lane.

sources.excerpt: Fall back and regroup. Don't fight split.

cards.speech: Kill window: {count} near you {is_are} below {pct}% health. Commit if no one else is coming.
cards.rationale: Every enemy that could be near you is low (from their top-bar health) while you are healthy: a pick creates a numbers advantage.

sources.excerpt: Pick = killing a separated enemy / targeting low health or high threat to gain a numbers advantage.

cards.speech: {count} are dead{respawn}. Use the window with your team: push a lane or an objective.
cards.rationale: Greyed enemy portraits with respawn timers are a temporary numbers advantage to convert into objectives.

sources.excerpt: count survivors and take the highest-value safe action (objective, wave, reset) rather than chasing

cards.speech: {count} are dead{respawn}. Play safe near your guardian until they're back.
cards.rationale: With teammates respawning your side has no numbers advantage; avoid taking fights alone.

cards.speech: {count} haven't been seen for a while and you're pushed up. Expect a gank; stay near your wave.
cards.rationale: Enemies without a top-bar health bar have not been seen recently; pushing forward without that information invites a gank.

sources.excerpt: An enemy marker not seen on minimap for 20s+ while pushing
enemy markers disappear from the minimap while the player pushes forward

cards.speech: Your team has the numbers at {area}: {allies} against {enemies}. Join the fight if you can reach it.
cards.rationale: Joining a fight your team is winning converts the advantage; nearby enemies around you must be absent.

sources.section: ## 25. Spending too long in a dead lane
sources.excerpt: Lane is dead. Shove it and go help.
